beats.summary: Michael Scott announces the formation of the Michael Scott Paper Company and holds a grand opening pancake luncheon.

evidence.snippet: Michael: It's Britney bitch. And I am back, in the form of a new company. The Michael Scott Paper Company.

beats.summary: Kelly Kapoor tries to get Charles' attention by pretending to be the new receptionist named Kelly.

evidence.snippet: Kelly: Yes Charles? Yes, you wanted me?
Jim: The new receptionist is also named Kelly. So Kelly Kapoor has decided to hover around my desk, so that she can run into his Charles' office every time he calls for Kelly.

beats.summary: Pam struggles with her role in the new company, fearing she will be relegated to making copies again.

evidence.snippet: Pam: I make that one copy, and I become the girl who makes copies, and by the end of the day I'm receptionist again.
Michael: Listen. Listen listen listen listen listen listen. I need someone to make a copy of this. Because I don't make copies, I'm the boss.
